The '''Battle of Corrdair''' was a battle fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at [[Corrdair]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="ATMP" /> at some point before or in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperials]] sent [[All Terrain Missile Platform/Legends|All Terrain Missile Platforms]] to attack [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Limm Nix]] and the rest of the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance forces]] that were stationed there.<ref name="ATMP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Corrdair was first mentioned in the "AT-MP (All Terrain Missile Platform)" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of [[LucasArts]]' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="ATMP" />
